title: Moment Valkyrie of Dazzle

body.intro:
* Story *

There is a mysterious forest where fogs hang over.
Ariko barely wakes up there dizzy condition.
Noticing that things around her changed strangely,
She moves toward her purpose stored deep in her memory.
The purpose is to save her important friend......

"Where am I..." She ponders while walking.
Suddenly, there appeared a talking rabbit doll before her.

"Hi Valkyrie, welcome to this "Kill or Die" world! Kihi!"

* The Game System of "Last Valkyrie of dream" Further Evolved! *

- Play time and entire volume drastically increased!
- Omitted "Tackle Attack"!
- Omitted "Picture Story Show Style Scenario"!
- Authentic ARPG. QTEs in sexual harassment and defeat pixel H scenes are more polished!
- Voice can be turned ON / OFF.
- "Zetsubou Rondo (lit. Rondo of Despair)" stage added! Begins from the BADEND!
An overwhelming cluster of penises chases after the heroine running from place to place!
Even if she were pregnant, the enemy would show no mercy. Contains birthing animation.

* Game System *
- Action based attacks are employed. As her level increases, battles would get easier.
- Trilemma shaped advantage / disadvantage chart still exist. Strike down enemies effectively.
- More elaborated Hack & Slash system with wider range of equipment.
- A dungeon style ARPG to go over a mysterious tower.
- More than 5 bosses. All bosses have their own pixel-based animations.
- Of minor enemies, both with / without H scenes mixed.
- Pixel art for status effects are loaded.
- Reminiscence room is available after game clear (all scenes can be viewed).

* All H Scenes Are Pixel Animation *
- QTE H Animations: 12 scenes

- Defeat H Animations:
Minor - 1 base / 4 variations
Boss - 6
Special Enemy - 1

- Birthing Scene: 1

Average Play Time: Approx. 3~4 hours or more (estimated)

* The save data can be transferred from the trial version to the retail version.

This game is created with RPG TKool VX Ace.
RPG Tkool VX Ace RTP software is NOT required.
Recommend purchase with DLsite account for updates.

Resolution: 640x480
